units.source_text: 千重子仿佛觉得触动了父亲的伤心事，不由得默默低下头来。

en.t: Chieko felt as though she had touched on something painful for her father, and without meaning to, she silently lowered her head.

units.source_text: 她拾掇好吃烫豆腐用的餐具，端到厨房去，从厨房里走出来又问：“庵主呢……”

en.t: She gathered up the dishes used for eating hot tofu and carried them to the kitchen, then came back out and asked again, "And the abbess..."
